arguments.command:
$src = "D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1839SliceFillingActual.lean"
$ole = "D:\lean\.lake\build\lib\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper\S1839SliceFillingActual.olean"
Write-Output "=== source ==="
Get-Item $src | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List
Get-FileHash $src -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash | Format-List
Write-Output "=== olean ==="
Get-Item $ole | Select-Object FullName,Length,LastWriteTime | Format-List
Get-FileHash $ole -Algorithm SHA256 | Select-Object Hash | Format-List
Write-Output "=== report ==="
Get-Item "D:\lean\coord\reports\S1839-slice-filling-counterexample.md" | Select-Object FullName,Length | Format-List
Write-Output "=== ledger tail check ==="
Select-String -Path "D:\lean\AUDIT_LEDGER.md" -Pattern "S1839" | Select-Object LineNumber,Line | Format-List
Write-Output "=== leftover probes ==="
Get-ChildItem "D:\lean\tmp\sheaf\xif\paper" -Filter "_S1839*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name
